device.basis: Power control of X-T20 2.11 stage 2 (0xc098..0xc4ec) and section 5 (0xc4cbec..0xc4d284). Five power domains, numbered 2..6, use masks 0x1, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80 and 0x100. Switching on (0xc4d108) sets the mask in +0x0c, waits for it in the status +0x2c, sets it in +0x08 and waits for the mask shifted left by 16. Switching off (0xc4cbec) clears it in +0x14 and +0x08, waits for the shifted mask to clear, clears it in +0x10 and +0x0c and waits until the status masked with the domain and bits 30..31 reads 0xc0000000. The status carries +0x0c bits 0..15 and +0x08 bits 0..13 in bits 16..29, with bits 30 and 31 set: switching completes at once. +0x10, +0x14 and +0x38 (bits 0, 1 and 4, 0xc4cf20/0xc4cfbc) read back their last write; the words start at 0, because the values the stage before the kernel leaves are not known. +0x00 reads 6 and +0x04 reads 1 on the running camera (service-mode reads). 0xc4cb94 clears +0x04 bit 0 only on the shutdown and fatal-stop paths (via 0xc4c9a4 from 0xc4d4ec), which end in endless loops, so a cleared bit 0 ends the run as supply off. No domain switches before REC and the menu.
